name: Toll Booth
summary: Small road toll booth with a window and a striped barrier arm that lifts with anim open. For highway and road scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the booth stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: about 700 px wide and 520 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: open = the barrier arm lifts over 40 frames

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (the barrier then sits on the left)

author: krakujs
